notes: pig-rea in a closed Binary: the same members and skills, and it refuses overlay Piglets, -e, settings extensions, mcp.json servers and installs, so the tool surface is identical on every machine. For CI and for evidence compared across runs.
Build the payload first (node components/rea/scripts/payload.mjs), then npm run build:piglet -- pig-rea-sealed.
The manifest lists five build targets, but only darwin/arm64 has been built and run; the others are listed in the manifest and not yet built, so no other platform is a support claim.
